headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, led by AI‑driven revenue gains.
summary: Revenue rose across the sector, with TCS reporting ₹73,188 cr and a 24% margin. HCLTech and LTM highlighted strong AI sales, while Wipro saw modest margin expansion. Profitability was mixed; Persistent posted a 25% profit decline. Dividend payouts remained robust.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: TCS, HCLTech, LTM and Wipro all cited AI revenue contributions and deal wins.

themes.title: Dividend strength
themes.detail: Most companies announced or maintained healthy interim dividends.

leaders.why: Largest revenue and highest operating margin (24%).
Strong AI revenue growth and clear FY27 guidance.

laggards.why: Profit fell 25% YoY and operating margin slipped to 15%.
Results not yet released, creating uncertainty.
